items.prompt: Flat network illustration, landscape, four-zone layout, pale blue background, blue and teal palette, green only for the correct item, clean lines. Zone A (left, about 60% width): a courier depot scene — a courier loads a parcel marked with a small globe onto a lorry; behind the lorry a long dotted route stretches across the panel passing a city skyline, a mountain range, a coastline and finally a foreign landmark tower; small waypoint markers sit along the route and a map board on the wall shows the same cross-continent line; a bicycle courier waits with a small local parcel for comparison; a clipboard, a scale and a stack of boxes complete the depot; the cross-continent route is highlighted. Zone B (upper right): three nested coverage zones drawn as a small circle, a medium circle and a very large circle — each containing a labelled building or city sketch; the largest circle is outlined in green with a tick above it; beneath each circle sits a small abbreviation plate; dotted connectors show the three zones nested inside one another. Zone C (lower right): a pale card with two rows of small abbreviation plaques, each row struck through with a thin grey line. Zone D (bottom full-width bar): a pale blue rounded conclusion strip with a green check badge. Text on the image is Simplified Chinese only, in three short labels: "广域网", "跨城市", "范围最大" — bold sans-serif on white rounded plates, each label no more than four characters. 16:9 landscape, high resolution, clean background.

Zone C (lower right): a pale card with three rows of small tags, each row struck through with a thin line. Zone D (bottom full-width bar): a cream rounded conclusion strip with a green check badge.
